verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own help docs say it supports managing multiple companies (entities) under one login, which covers the multi-entity half of the story. Consolidated financials appear only through a documented Joiin integration for multi-entity reporting, an extra third-party tool rather than native consolidation. Missing for 10: native consolidated financial statements, intercompany eliminations, detail on how the Joiin consolidation works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can manage multiple legal entities and produce consolidated financials across them

citations.quote: Puzzle supports managing multiple companies (entities) under one login.
